svg.desc: GYM articulated exercise illustration. Original parametric geometry; visual reference: Workout Guide by Bryl Lim / Everkinetic (https://bryllim.github.io/workout-guide/exercises/). 20 samples/second plus phase boundaries; native SVG interpolates between solver samples.
